items.name: Cube Is Good 2016
items.information: This competition is part of "Play X4", a gaming exhibition in Korea. Registration fee: first event 5000 WON, each additional event 1000 WON. Registration starts on April 13 and closes May 20th, 11:59 PM. Prepayment is required.

items.name: Pekalongan Rubik's Competition 2016

venue.name: Maem Chicken
venue.details: Across from the Pekalongan firehouse / firefighters office

items.information: The registration fee would be charged per event. The maximum payment for early bird is IDR 100.000 and maximum IDR 150.000 for on the spot payment. For further information you can contact the contact person or check it at [the website](http://pekalonganrubikscompetition2016.weebly.com/registration.html).
